description: Bare-minimum file: OIO and grounds present but cryptic. No written submissions, no cited authorities, no evidence index. Exercises the empty-variable path on optional fields.

variables.MATTER_TITLE: M/s ABC Traders v. Assistant Commissioner, CGST Range-3, Nashik
variables.OIO_TEXT: OIO No. 12/2024-25 dated 02 December 2024. Demand of CGST INR 4,86,200 and SGST INR 4,86,200 confirmed under Section 73 for FY 2021-22 on the ground of excess ITC availed against GSTR-2A mismatch. Interest and penalty under Section 50 / Section 73(9) also confirmed.
variables.GOA_TEXT: Ground 1: The impugned order proceeds on the sole basis of GSTR-2A mismatch without examining the underlying invoices and supplier returns. Ground 2: Personal hearing was granted but adjournment request was not considered. Ground 3: Interest and penalty are not sustainable in the absence of any finding of fraud or suppression.
variables.PREDEPOSIT_TEXT: Pre-deposit of 10% of disputed tax paid vide DRC-03 dated 18 February 2025. Receipt on record.
variables.LIMITATION_TEXT: OIO date: 02 December 2024. Service date: 05 December 2024. Appeal filed: 03 March 2025. Within three months under Section 107(1).
